threat_results.threat_name: Host Compromise via Malicious C Binary
threat_results.remaining_limitation: Docker container shares host Linux kernel; microVM virtualization (e.g. Firecracker) provides stronger hypervisor isolation

threat_results.threat_name: Denial of Service via Resource Exhaustion
threat_results.remaining_limitation: Container creation overhead (~1.2-1.5s per turn) under burst traffic requires warm pool optimization

threat_results.implemented_mitigation: Docker network isolation flag --net=none (loopback only, no external IP routing)
threat_results.remaining_limitation: In-band covert channels via CPU timing remain theoretical possibilities

threat_results.implemented_mitigation: Container root mounted strictly read-only; dedicated 32MB tmpfs mounted at /workspace (noexec on root)
threat_results.remaining_limitation: Tmpfs is volatile and cleared upon container exit

threat_results.implemented_mitigation: Technical scoring performed by deterministic SBERT+FAISS+CrossEncoder (zero LLM evaluation); ScoreValidator caps
threat_results.remaining_limitation: Dense keyword strings can achieve partial CrossEncoder collocation hits, bounded by ScoreValidator

threat_results.implemented_mitigation: UUIDv4 unguessable session tokens; SQL queries strictly parameterized and scoped by candidate_id / session_id
threat_results.remaining_limitation: API uses capability tokens without cryptographic JWT signatures

threat_results.implemented_mitigation: SQLite Write-Ahead Logging (WAL) mode, 30.0s busy timeout, thread lock synchronization
threat_results.remaining_limitation: Single-file SQLite write lock ceiling (~150-200 ops/sec); horizontal scaling requires Postgres
